rationale: The agent identified a user via name and ZIP and retrieved some order details, but then executed a return (return_delivered_order_items) without first confirming with the user, violating the requirement to confirm every order-changing action before taking it. The agent also failed to provide the requested refund amount or any summary of what was returned vs. kept. The final message contains no actionable information and does not report outcomes. These issues constitute a clear policy violation and failure to complete the user’s request in line with the policy.
